name: HandymanAI
summary:
HandymanAI brings trade training and an AI assistant into your space. Panels float over your room in passthrough, so you can learn and ask questions while you look at the real equipment.

Training
• 22 lessons across electrical, HVAC, plumbing and cleaning, with quizzes.
• Turn 3D equipment in front of you: a pole-mount transformer, a substation, an outdoor heat pump, a gas furnace, a water heater, a conduit bend and a P-trap.
